## Outcome
Complete the standalone issue-to-PR-to-guarded-merge journey while GoalBuddy remains canonical.

## Acceptance criteria
- All dependency-ready items complete with canonical receipts.
- GitHub effects remain exact-repository, idempotent, and reconciled.
- Each board-created pull request passes fresh merge gates.
- Standalone package dogfood and T999 closeout pass.

## Non-goals
- AOL source or runtime integration
- External model providers
- Schedules or auto-merge
- Deployment or release publication
- Repository settings or secrets

## Work items
- [ ] `T010` — Review and correct the standalone Orcastrata plan
- [ ] `T020` — Record exact implementation authority
- [ ] `T030` — Implement credential-blind GitHub reads
- [ ] `T040` — Project GoalBuddy work into a GitHub umbrella
- [ ] `T050` — Create and reconcile Orcastrata-managed issues
- [ ] `T060` — Run bounded issue workers and PR lifecycle
- [ ] `T070` — Implement /orcastrata-audit-full
- [ ] `T080` — Merge board-created pull requests through fresh gates
- [ ] `T090` — Run standalone Orcastrata dogfood acceptance
- [ ] `T999` — Close the Orcastrata umbrella lifecycle

## Dependency order
- `T020` blocked by `T010`
- `T030` blocked by `T020`
- `T040` blocked by `T030`
- `T050` blocked by `T040`
- `T060` blocked by `T050`
- `T070` blocked by `T050`
- `T080` blocked by `T060`, `T070`
- `T090` blocked by `T080`
- `T999` blocked by `T090`
